description: CSUTLDTC, the called date-validation subprogram, invoked as the @Service it became. LS-DATE='2022-13-15' and LS-DATE-FORMAT='YYYY-MM-DD' are this case's two LINKAGE SECTION parameters (L84-L85); LS-RESULT PIC X(80) (L86) is the output and is asserted below as the single WS_MESSAGE_80 line. This program opens no file and is reached by no JCL, so it seeds no dataset, writes no record and takes no job parameter - its entire observable behaviour is the 80 bytes L97 moves into LS-RESULT and the severity L98 moves into RETURN-CODE. Expected values are STATICALLY DERIVED from the 01 WS-MESSAGE declaration at L42-L57 and the group move at L122, never captured from a COBOL run, which is impossible here. Arm 6 at the UPPER out-of-range month, 13. Together with case12 this drives both sides of the 1-to-12 guard; a check written as 'month > 12' alone would pass case13 and fail case12, and one written as 'month < 1' alone would do the reverse.
